scope: Independent before/current High Perches two-view full appearance/material/nature/contact/party-overlap/readability review.

inspection.method: All complete originals opened with view_image; no crops or edits.

before.reason: Continuous central blue/gold paving, circular banner pad and visible pillar bases meet turf without broad green wedges or large gaps. Trainer/near lane remain clear. Vista merges insect and bird heads/chests/wings into one silhouette. Coarse repeated brown pillar material, distorted-looking ring pattern and wide uniform turf lack the reference finish; neither view exposes the near drop clearly.

current.reason: Central circular paving and visible base/pad edges remain coherent, without large grass wedges. Trainer and near lane are open. Small dark shrubs/flower clumps add some variation around the right/background turf, but the broad ground and coarse huge pillars remain unfinished. Vista bird wings/body overlap a large horned body behind them, forming another fused silhouette and obscuring the left scenery.

local_comparisons.preference: No full-appearance preference; both maintain local paving/near-trainer readability
local_comparisons.reason: Both show clear trainer, central circle and near approach. Current distant horned creature and other actor poses differ; no identity/spacing cause or actor-position equivalence inferred.

local_comparisons.preference: CURRENT only for modest visible shrub/flower dressing; no overall PASS preference
local_comparisons.reason: Current right/background turf has additional small dark leafy/flower clusters. Both have severe overlap of large left companion silhouettes, coarse pillar material and an obscured near drop. The overlap remains a visible defect rather than a resolved separation result.

contact_limits: Only visible center/perimeter sections and base faces. Hidden rear court, surface beneath actors, full pillar circumference and terrain underside are unassessed. No support/collision inference.
height_drop_limits: Banner/sky/distant cliff fragments give local orientation, but near rim/downward drop is not clearly pictured. No arrival/departure/Fly/landing-transition assessment.
visible_regressions: No clear new broad paving/ground gap or trainer burial is visible. The current vista still suffers actor overlap; pose/species differences alone do not establish a new system regression.
owning_requirement: Coherent architecture/nature/material finish, continuous visible paving/ground unions and distinct readable actor silhouettes/route.
limits: Two staged production-camera High1080 stills per set only. No earned arrival, motion, co-op, device, full matrix or whole criterion claim.
No mechanical support, walkability, collision, implementation cause, spacing-system or identity-system inference.
Weather and unchanged actor position are not asserted. Actor silhouettes/poses differ and are judged only as pictured.
No source/config/manifest/log/receipt/private binding/runtime conclusion or numeric grade read. No catalogue rerating.
Original 253bd whole FAIL, five Bridge full-bar FAIL comparisons and previous witnesses remain untouched.
